schemaVersion.description: Major schema version. Consumers reject unknown majors; within a major only optional fields are added.

networkId.description: Canonical network identifier from spec/networks.json. Never a bare chain ID or CCTP domain.

rawAmount.description: Unsigned integer in the token's smallest unit, as a decimal string without leading zeros. At most i64::MAX (Stellar classic asset limit).

stellarAddress.description: Stellar strkey: G (account), C (contract) or M (muxed account). Checksums are verified by the codec (C06).

txId.description: EVM tx hash (0x + 64 hex) or Stellar tx hash (64 hex).
